title: PULSE: Personalized Opportunistic Learning for Wearable Devices
abstract: arXiv:2610.28081v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Wearable devices increasingly support personalized health and well-being applications, but post-deployment data can differ substantially from those used for training, while purely local adaptation may be limited by the data available on a single device during real-world operation. Conventional federated and decentralized learning rely on recurrent communication and stable connectivity, whereas existing opportunistic approaches often exploit available encounters without adequately considering their utility, compatibility, or communication cost.   We propose PULSE, an event-driven framework for personalized opportunistic learning that treats each encounter as an online collaboration decision, selecting either no interaction or a promising nearby peer. translated_title: PULSE：面向可穿戴设备的个性化机会学习
translated_abstract: 可穿戴设备日益支持个性化健康与福祉类应用，但部署后采集的数据可能与训练所用数据存在显著差异，而在真实运行环境中，纯本地自适应往往受限于单一设备上可获得的数据。传统联邦学习与去中心化学习依赖周期性通信和稳定连接，而现有的机会式方法通常只是利用可用的设备相遇机会，却未充分考虑其效用、兼容性或通信成本。我们提出PULSE——一个用于个性化机会学习的事件驱动框架，它将每一次设备相遇视为一次在线协作决策：要么选择不进行交互，要么选择一个有前景的邻近节点。只有当对等节点的梯度与本地学习方向兼容时才会被纳入，同时过去的交互经验会指导未来的节点选择。在人体活动识别、跌倒检测等任务上……（原文摘要截断）
tldr: PULSE提出了一种事件驱动的个性化机会学习框架，将可穿戴设备间的每次相遇视为在线协作决策，仅在梯度与本地学习方向兼容时融合对等节点信息，从而在无稳定连接的条件下解决部署后数据分布差异带来的个性化学习难题。
en_tdlr: PULSE proposes an event-driven personalized opportunistic learning framework that treats each wearable device encounter as an online collaboration decision, incorporating peer gradients only when compatible with the local learning direction, enabling personalization under data shifts and unstable connectivity without recurrent communication.
